about: Names that mark an input field as secret even when the framework does not set UIA IsPassword (Avalonia's TextBox with a PasswordChar does not - probe 2026-11-20) or the AX tree calls it a plain textbox. A field whose Name matches is treated as a password field: set_secret, denied, value never read or logged. Matched case-insensitively as substrings.
source: field:2026-11-20 Avalonia 11.2 gallery probe; doc: common UI vocabulary
